headline: Internal links follow browser bases; persona labels and disclosures stay readable.

items.title: Browser-faithful reference validation
items.insight: The validator now resolves relative bases as the browser does. A baseline mutation proves that a missing browser target previously passed. Active base attributes and inert content have focused regression coverage.
items.evidence: 49 self-tests;16 real Chromium cases;339-page reference scan; retained baseline mutation.

items.title: Readable persona copy and disclosure clearance
items.insight: Light persona labels use readable text colors while decorative accents retain their identity. Spark yields around actual note text and stays recallable from the header. Fingerprinted styles deliver the repair to returning visitors.
items.evidence: 23 browser checks;minimum sampled contrast6.04:1;215 mobile cells;112 final persona and28 supplemental disclosure states inspected.
